fusions.name: Whispered Word
fusions.desc: A word spoken under the breath deals 30 damage at up to 8 tiles and ignores the target's resistances.

fusions.name: Muttered Darts
fusions.desc: Looses 3 small darts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Quick Recitation
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Short Incantations
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner.
